verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents a Python plugin system (Functions, Tools) and SKILL.md skills. Its homepage says users can "Share what you build, run what others share," which points to a community sharing ecosystem. The pack does not describe a browsable registry or a one-command or one-click install flow, so support is only a glancing mention. Missing for 10: a documented browsable skills/plugins registry, a one-click or one-command install mechanism, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of installing from a registry.

support.subject: As a power user, I can browse a real skills/plugins registry and install a capability with one command or click

citations.quote: Share what you build, run what others share.
Functions are modular Python plugins that extend the capabilities of Open WebUI itself.
A skill is a folder with a SKILL.md file: a reusable instruction set the AI can pull in on demand
